summary: Classifies generated Release Please pull requests from their changelog heading and advances the host chart from the current protected base.

notes: This release-workflow correction does not change application data or migrations.

security: Only an added breaking-change heading in the generated changelog patch is considered, and only for the repository's Release Please branch.
Release preparation accepts only a generated release pull request targeting the protected main branch.
documentation: Release workflow contract coverage records breaking-heading classification and protected-base chart versioning.
knownLimitations: Manual pull requests continue to use title, checked checklist, or BREAKING-CHANGE declaration classification.
rollback: Revert the labeler, chart preparation, and contract-test changes; manually label and correct any affected generated release pull request before protected checks.
validation: Run the release-label and release-note workflow contract tests and deterministic CI change-detection suite.
Verify the release-label contract test selects only release-readiness workflow evidence rather than unrelated application, database, image, or engine lanes.
